name: Big Top

categories.label: Completed attraction cards
categories.labelVi: Điểm thẻ trò diễn đã hoàn thành
categories.hint: Sum of the points printed on your completed attractions only.

categories.label: Completed clown cards
categories.labelVi: Điểm thẻ chú hề đã hoàn thành
categories.hint: Score each completed clown card as described on the player screen (printed on the screen, not in the rulebook).

categories.label: Coins ($) behind screen and on unfinished cards
categories.labelVi: Tiền ($) sau màn chắn và trên thẻ chưa xong

categories.label: Stars on completed attractions
categories.labelVi: Số sao trên thẻ đã hoàn thành
categories.hint: Most stars 10 VP, 2nd 7, 3rd 3. Tied players all get the lower amount. No star on a completed attraction = eliminated, cannot win.

winCondition: Highest total points wins, but any player with no star on a completed attraction is eliminated and cannot win. Tied players share the victory.

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when someone draws the Game End card from the attraction deck.

notes: family: auction-money. Only completed cards score. Clown card scoring is printed on player screens and is entered as a number. Star rank ties: rulebook says all tied players earn the lowest amount; with a 3-way tie for first the template gives the 2nd-place value (7) instead of 3 - adjust manually. Eliminated (no-star) players are not modelled automatically.
